# Load libraries

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratObject)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)
library(egg)
library(Polychrome)
library(dplyr)
library(workflowr)
library(here)
library(sessioninfo)

source(here("code", "helper_functions.R"))
source(here("code", "load_colour_schemes.R"))

RERUN_ALL <- FALSE
```

# Load in the integrated dataset

```{r}
seu.Gerli <- readRDS(here("data", "Gerli_et_al_2024", 
                              "Gerli_et_al_2024.Celltypist_annotated.Seurat.rds"))
seu.Gerli$Dataset_Source <- "Gerli et al. (2024)"

dim(seu.Gerli)
```

```{r}
# add in our refined labels (cells with low quality/doublet labels are removed from this object)
seu.Gerli_filtered <- readRDS(here("data", "Gerli_et_al_2024", "Gerli_et_al_2024.Refined_labels.Seurat.rds"))

seu.Gerli$manuscript_cluster_labels <- "REMOVED"
seu.Gerli@meta.data[colnames(seu.Gerli_filtered),"manuscript_cluster_labels"] <- as.character(seu.Gerli_filtered$cluster_names)

rm(seu.Gerli_filtered)
gc()
```

```{r}
seu.AmnioSC <- readRDS(here("data", "workflow", 
                                "AmnioSC_ALL_optimised_ref.Celltypist_annotated.Seurat.rds"))
seu.AmnioSC$Dataset_Source <- "Our Dataset"

dim(seu.AmnioSC)
```

```{r}
# add in our refined labels (cells with low quality/doublet labels are removed from this object)
seu.AmnioSC_filtered <- readRDS(here("data", "workflow", "AmnioSC_ALL_optimised_ref.Refined_labels.Seurat.rds"))

seu.AmnioSC$manuscript_cluster_labels <- "REMOVED"
seu.AmnioSC@meta.data[colnames(seu.AmnioSC_filtered),"manuscript_cluster_labels"] <- as.character(seu.AmnioSC_filtered$cluster_names)

rm(seu.AmnioSC_filtered)

```

# Try a simple merge of the raw counts

```{r}
common_genes <- intersect(rownames(seu.AmnioSC), rownames(seu.Gerli))
length(common_genes)

intersect(colnames(seu.AmnioSC@meta.data), colnames(seu.Gerli@meta.data))
```

```{r}
cols_to_merge <- c("Dataset", "Dataset_Source", "Sample", "Donor", "Barcode", 
                   "foetal_sex", "pan_fetal.predicted_labels", "pan_fetal.majority_voting", 
                   "pan_fetal.prob_pred", "pan_fetal.prob_vote", "pan_fetal.decision_pred", 
                   "pan_fetal.decision_vote", "fetal_organ.predicted_labels", 
                   "fetal_organ.majority_voting", "fetal_organ.prob_pred", 
                   "fetal_organ.prob_vote", "fetal_organ.decision_pred", "fetal_organ.decision_vote", 
                   "cmv_status", "gest_age_weeks", "Donor.gest_age", "manuscript_cluster_labels")

object <- here("data", "merged", "AmnioSC.Gerli_et_al_2024.Preprocessed_Merged.Seurat.rds")
if (!file.exists(object) | RERUN_ALL) {
  # create Seurat object
  metadata_df <- rbind(seu.AmnioSC@meta.data[,cols_to_merge],
                       seu.Gerli@meta.data[,cols_to_merge])
  
  seu <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = cbind(GetAssayData(object = seu.AmnioSC, assay = "RNA", 
                                                        slot = "counts")[common_genes,],
                                           GetAssayData(object = seu.Gerli, assay = "RNA", 
                                                        slot = "counts")[common_genes,]),
                            meta.data = metadata_df)
  
  seu$early_late_gestation <- ifelse(seu$gest_age_weeks <= 19, "Early",
                                ifelse(seu$gest_age_weeks >= 23, "Late", 
                                       "Mid"))
  
  # rename batch variable
  seu$Dataset_Batch <- seu$Dataset
  seu$Dataset <- NULL
  
  # match our name formatting
  seu$Donor.Paper <- ifelse(seu$Donor %in% names(DONOR.PAPER), DONOR.PAPER[seu$Donor], seu$Donor)
  seu$Sample.Paper <- ifelse(seu$Sample %in% names(SAMPLE.PAPER), SAMPLE.PAPER[seu$Sample], seu$Sample)
  
  # add extra metadata
  combined_metadata <- readr::read_csv(here("data", "Gerli_et_al_2024", "combined_metadata.csv"))
  combined_metadata <- as.data.frame(combined_metadata)
  rownames(combined_metadata) <- combined_metadata$Sample
  
  combined_metadata <- combined_metadata[seu$Donor,]
  rownames(combined_metadata) <- colnames(seu)
  
  stopifnot(combined_metadata$gest_age == seu$gest_age_weeks)
  stopifnot(combined_metadata$foetal_sex == seu$foetal_sex)
  stopifnot(combined_metadata$dataset_batch == seu$Dataset_Batch)
  
  seu@meta.data <- cbind(seu@meta.data, combined_metadata[,c("trimester", "abnormalities", "outcome", "procedure")])
  
  saveRDS(seu, object)
} else {
  seu <- readRDS(object)
}

rm(seu.Gerli)
rm(seu.AmnioSC)
gc()
```

```{r}
table(seu$Donor.Paper)
table(seu$Sample.Paper)
```

```{r}
table(seu$Dataset_Source)
table(seu$Dataset_Batch, seu$Dataset_Source)
table(seu$Donor, seu$Dataset_Source)
table(seu$gest_age_weeks, seu$Dataset_Source)
```

```{r}
gc()
object <- here("data", "merged", "AmnioSC.Gerli_et_al_2024.DimRed_Merged.Seurat.rds")
if (!file.exists(object) | RERUN_ALL) {
  # need to change this so SCTransform stops crashing
  options(future.globals.maxSize = 8000 * 1024^2)
  seu <- SCTransform(seu, method = "glmGamPoi")
  gc()
  seu <- RunPCA(seu, verbose = FALSE)
  gc()
  seu <- RunUMAP(seu, dims = 1:30, verbose = FALSE)
  saveRDS(seu, object)
} else {
  seu <- readRDS(object)
}
gc()
```

```{r}
DimPlot(seu, group.by = "Dataset_Source")
DimPlot(seu, group.by = "Dataset_Batch")
```

# Try integrating the two datasets

```{r}
gc()
object <- here("data", "merged", "AmnioSC.Gerli_et_al_2024.Integrated.Seurat.rds")
if (!file.exists(object) | RERUN_ALL) {
  seu <- readRDS(here("data", "merged", "AmnioSC.Gerli_et_al_2024.Preprocessed_Merged.Seurat.rds"))
  
  seu <- seu[, which(seu$pan_fetal.majority_voting != "HIGH_MITO")]
  seu <- seu[, which(seu$pan_fetal.majority_voting != "DOUBLET_LYMPHOID_MACROPHAGE")]
  seu <- seu[, seu$pan_fetal.majority_voting != "LOW_QUALITY"]
  gc()
  seu_int <- integrateDataset(seu, "Dataset_Source")
  saveRDS(seu_int, object)
} else {
  seu_int <- readRDS(object)
}
gc()
```

dim(seu_int)

# Save the objects for upload

```{r}
# Integrated object with both datasets
saveRDS(seu_int, here("output", "data_to_upload", "AmnioSC.Gerli_et_al_2024.Integrated.Seurat.rds"))

# Combined metadata for both datasets
combined_metadata <- readr::read_csv(here("data", "Gerli_et_al_2024", "combined_metadata.csv"))
readr::write_csv(combined_metadata, here("output", "data_to_upload", "AmnioSC.Gerli_et_al_2024.combined_metadata.csv"))

# Annotated object with just our data
seu.AmnioSC_filtered <- readRDS(here("data", "workflow", "AmnioSC_ALL_optimised_ref.Refined_labels.Seurat.rds"))

# Neaten up names for consistency with the integrated dataset
seu.AmnioSC_filtered$Dataset_Batch <- seu.AmnioSC_filtered$Dataset
seu.AmnioSC_filtered$Dataset_Source <- "Our Dataset"
seu.AmnioSC_filtered$Dataset <- NULL
seu.AmnioSC_filtered@meta.data[, startsWith(colnames(seu.AmnioSC_filtered@meta.data), "integrated_snn")] <- NULL

# remove variables created during subclustering
seu.AmnioSC_filtered$all_clusters <- NULL
seu.AmnioSC_filtered$seurat_clusters <- NULL

saveRDS(seu.AmnioSC_filtered, here("output", "data_to_upload", "AmnioSC_optref.Refined_labels.Seurat.rds"))
```
